Clear this device

Private by design. Honest about the limits.

FlowTrack sends no transaction data anywhere. There are no accounts, analytics, ads, trackers, or cloud sync. Records are stored in this browser’s local storage, without encryption. Anyone with access to this browser profile can see them.

Clearing site data, private browsing, browser cleanup, or losing this device can erase your records. Backups and exports contain readable financial data; protect them. A different browser or website address has a separate ledger. Your hosting provider may receive standard web request logs when the app loads.

Free and open source, made for everyday progress. An Ikomeflow / Futura Group project.
